title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. It is influenced by the complexity of the model.

title: Impact of Features on Variance
text: The choice of features can impact the model variance because adding more features can increase the complexity of the model, which in turn can increase the variance.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: In the bias-variance tradeoff, increasing model complexity typically decreases bias but increases variance. The choice of features affects this tradeoff.
